newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - June 24.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - June 24.

text.p: -- Tele-Communications Inc is close to executing a series of partnerships with Time Warner Inc and others that will allow it to lower its debt by more than $1.1 billion and would shrink its subscriber base by 800,000, the Wall Street Journal reported. TCI closed at 16-3/13 Monday and Time Warner closed at 47-3/8.

-- Computer Sciences Corp said it expects a fiscal first quarter tax benefit of $135 million and an after-tax special charge of $133 million, both related to recent developments at an affiliated joint venture, for a net gain of $2 million, or $0.02 per share. The stock closed at 73.

-- UtiliCorp United Inc and PECO Energy Co are set to launch a new company with AT&T Corp, offering consumers a one-stop shopping service for a variety of utilities, the Wall Street Journal reported. UtiliCorp closed at 27-1/4, PECO closed at 20-1/2, and AT&T closed at 36-1/4.

-- CFC International Inc said it expects its second quarter earnings to fall short of analysts' estimates. It cited capacity concerns in its printed products line. The First Call mean earnings estimate is $0.25 per share.
